_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil statistics and 97% base rate of ±2-point moves make HOLD the statistically honest call; neither the UP breaker (ETF flows >30 + stablecoin growth positive) nor the DOWN breaker (VIX >20 + funding negative + BTC losing $62K) is present.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction citing absent breakers; narrative implies UP with high conviction citing bottom analog; leaning analyst per trust weight and coil evidence.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 24-31 range with VIX 17-20, funding flat, and no ETF flow revival over next 2-3 12h windows
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows spike above 30 (signals Hope/Optimism transition UP) OR BTC breaks below $60K with funding negative and VIX >22 (signals Panic/Capitulation leg DOWN)
